hooks.command: input=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE '(rm -rf|rm -r /|rmdir /|del /f|format c:|drop table|drop database|truncate table|delete from .+ where 1|:.*\(\).*\{.*:|curl.*\|.*bash|wget.*\|.*bash)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command detected. Confirm with Mario before running this.'; exit 2; fi; exit 0

echo 'End-of-turn checklist: (1) If you touched .ts/.tsx — did you run npx tsc --noEmit and confirm zero errors? (2) Did you re-read the patched section to confirm the edit landed correctly? (3) If this was a bug fix — did you add a row to tasks/lessons.md? (4) Is tasks/todo.md current? Do not mark done until all four are yes.'
